# SmartRUN (Smart Run) — Kolkata Electrical & Construction Materials Delivery

> SmartRUN (SmartRun Materials Pvt. Ltd.) is an express quick-commerce platform and Android application for electrical supplies, construction and building materials, and licensed electrician booking in Kolkata and Howrah, West Bengal, India.

## Official Brand & Entity Details
- Brand Name: SmartRUN (also searched as Smart Run, SmartRUN India, SmartRUN Kolkata)
- Legal Entity: SmartRun Materials Pvt. Ltd.
- Official Website: https://www.smartrun.in
- Official Android App (Google Play): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.smartrun.app
- Android Package ID: in.smartrun.app
- Registered Office: Kheyadah Village, Bhagabanpur, Kolkata 700150, West Bengal, India
- Operational Dispatch Depot: SmartRun Kasba Central Depot, Kasba Industrial Estate Phase 1, Kolkata 700107, West Bengal, India
- Support Phone / WhatsApp: +91 87774 00280 / +91 90071 68561
- Support Email: team@smartrun.in (Grievances: grievance@smartrun.in)
- Operating Hours: Monday–Sunday, 08:00 AM – 09:00 PM IST

## Core Categories & Offerings
- **Electrical Supplies**: IS 694 wires and house cables (Polycab, RR Kabel, Havells, Finolex) with color swatches, MCBs and distribution boards (Schneider Electric, Legrand), modular switches (Anchor by Panasonic), PVC conduits, LED lighting, ceiling/exhaust fans, CCTV, and inverters.
- **Construction & Building Supplies**: UltraTech & ACC cement bags, Tata Tiscon TMT rebars, Dr. Fixit waterproofing chemicals, Asian Paints wall putty, Astral & Supreme CPVC/UPVC pipes, CenturyPly plywood, sanitaryware, kitchen hardware, and Bosch power tools.
- **Certified Electricians**: Licensed electricians and wiring contractors verified with Government of West Bengal Electrical Licensing Board credentials for home wiring, switchboard setup, and emergency repairs.
- **Delivery Coverage**: Express 60-minute courier dispatch on eligible electrical orders across serviceable Kolkata metropolitan PIN codes (700001–700160) and Howrah PIN codes (711101–711106), plus scheduled commercial pickup delivery for heavy building supplies.

- [Construction Materials & Building Supplies](https://www.smartrun.in/construction): Catalog and contractor desk for cement, TMT steel, waterproofing, plumbing, plywood, and hardware.
- [Certified Electricians](https://www.smartrun.in/technicians): Directory of licensed electrical technicians in Kolkata.
- [SmartRUN Android & Web App](https://www.smartrun.in/app): Features of the in.smartrun.app Android application and Play Store link.
- [Delivery Service Areas](https://www.smartrun.in/delivery-areas): Kolkata & Howrah serviceable zones, PIN codes (700001–700160, 711101–711106), and interactive pincode checker.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.smartrun.in/faqs): Verified answers on 60-minute delivery, wire variants, GST invoices, COD/UPI payments, returns, and support.
- [How to Order Guide](https://www.smartrun.in/how-to-use): Step-by-step ordering, wire color selection, live GPS tracking, and invoice guide.
- [Contact & Support](https://www.smartrun.in/contact): Direct WhatsApp, phone, email, and depot contact information.
- [Shipping Policy](https://www.smartrun.in/shipping): 60-minute express delivery terms and heavy site freight SLAs.
- [Return Policy](https://www.smartrun.in/return): 7-day return and replacement policy.
- [Refund Policy](https://www.smartrun.in/refund-policy): Direct-to-source refund terms.
